200.description:
Every retail price row billed on one meter (GET /api/retail/prices?$filter=meterId eq '<guid>', optionally with armRegionName). One meter can back several SKUs (e.g. D2 v3 and D2s v3 share a meter), so a list is returned. An unknown meter GUID is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `items` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `arm_region_name` | string | ARM region slug, e.g. `eastus`. |
| `arm_sku_name` | string | ARM SKU name, e.g. `Standard_D2s_v3`; the empty string when the service has none (Synapse dedicated SQL pool rows). |
| `currency_code` | string | ISO 4217 billing currency of this row (the API's `currencyCode`). |
| `effective_end_date` | string | ISO 8601 instant the price stops applying; null when open-ended (the API omits the field). |
| `effective_start_date` | string | ISO 8601 instant the price took effect. |
| `is_primary_meter_region` | boolean |  |
| `location` | string | Region display name, e.g. `US East`. |
| `meter_id` | string | Billing meter GUID. Shared by SKUs that bill on the same meter; input to get_meter. |
| `meter_name` | string |  |
| `price_type` | string | The API's `type`: Consumption, DevTestConsumption or Reservation. |
| `product_id` | string |  |
| `product_name` | string |  |
| `reservation_term` | string | `1 Year` or `3 Years` on Reservation rows; null otherwise. |
| `retail_price` | number | Retail list price per `unit_of_measure`. |
| `savings_plan` | object[] | Savings-plan prices, only when `include_savings_plan` was requested (api-version 2023-01-01-preview) and the API returned them; null otherwise. |
| `service_family` | string |  |
| `service_id` | string |  |
| `service_name` | string |  |
| `sku_id` | string | `product_id` + `/` + SKU suffix. |
| `sku_name` | string |  |
| `tier_minimum_units` | number | Lower bound of the consumption tier this price applies from (0 for untiered meters). |
| `unit_of_measure` | string | As stated by the API, e.g. `1 Hour`, `1/Month`, `1 GB`. |
| `unit_price` | number | Unit price per `unit_of_measure` (equals retail_price for the Default retail entity). |

post.description: Start here for any 'what does X cost on Azure in region Y' question: Synapse dedicated SQL pool DWUs, virtual machine sizes, managed disks, storage tiers. Then call get_sku_prices with an `arm_sku_name` or get_meter with a `meter_id` from the results.

arm_region_name.description: ARM region slug (`armRegionName eq`), e.g. `eastus`, `westeurope`. Unknown regions return an empty result, not an error. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]{2,40}$.

continuation.description: `continuation` from the previous page (the API's `$skip` offset). Send the same filters again. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

currency_code.description:
Billing currency (`currencyCode`), ISO 4217. Default USD; EUR verified. Pattern: ^[A-Z]{3}$.

Provider reference: default "USD".

include_savings_plan.description: Request api-version 2023-01-01-preview, which adds `savings_plan` (1 Year / 3 Years) to eligible Consumption rows.

price_type.description:
`priceType eq`: Consumption (pay-as-you-go, spot, low priority), DevTestConsumption or Reservation. Omit for all types. Reservation scans over a whole service are expensive and the API answers them with HTTP 429; combine with a product or SKU filter.

Provider reference: allowed values ["Consumption", "DevTestConsumption", "Reservation"].

primary_meter_region_only.description: Send `meterRegion='primary'`: only rows where the region is the meter's primary region.

product_name.description: Exact `productName`, e.g. `Premium SSD Managed Disks`, `Azure Synapse Analytics Dedicated SQL Pool`. Mutually exclusive with `product_name_contains`.
